title: On the Computational Complexity of Bilevel Integer Linear Programming
summary: We investigate the computational complexity of bilevel integer linear programming. While Jeroslow~(1985) established that the decision version of this problem is $Σ^p_2$-complete when restricted to binary variables, we prove that this $Σ^p_2$-completeness persists even for general integer variables, settling a question that remained open for over 40 years. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of various structural assumptions on computational complexity.
